description: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, punctuation-to-space, whitespace collapse, removal of a leading 2-4 digit line code (Texas data control codes such as '1110', Illinois line numbers; '911' and likely years are kept; set strip_leading_codes to false to turn this off), then exact aliases. No stemming, no other digit deletion, no accounting synonym merging. Ambiguous labels include section/parent context in frequency keys.
